Polish-pass Option 3: Off-ball formation translation.

User feedback: "Just straight line running for the most part. Not football at all." Options 1 + 2 shipped at ca96e3a + 13a3b7b. Option-3 closes static-formation symptom: today hold-shape branch commands STATIC basePosition. When home attacks at +40m X, home back-four still at -30m X — 11 disconnected pucks not a compact unit.

Football reality: team shifts as compact block. Formation SHAPE preserved; CENTROID moves with ball.

acceptance:
- New constants in BehaviorTreeRunner: FormationBallShiftFactor = Fixed.FromInt(1)/Fixed.FromInt(2) (= 0.5 along X); LateralBallShiftFactor = Fixed.FromInt(3)/Fixed.FromInt(10) (= 0.3 along Z; smaller since pitch is narrower 68m vs longer 105m).
- New private helper BallTranslatedBasePosition(basePosition, ballPitchPosition): returns basePosition + (ball.X * 0.5, 0, ball.Z * 0.3), then clamped to pitch boundaries ±52.5 X / ±34 Z.
- Hold-shape branch (ONLY) uses BallTranslatedBasePosition; press + build-up + GK branches UNCHANGED.
- Determinism: Q32.32 throughout.
- 60-tick smoke hash MAY but PROBABLY stays UNCHANGED (smoke ball at origin tick 0 → translation = 0 vector for early ticks).
- 60-tick primed-fixture hash WILL drift (primed ball at cutback zone X=50 → all outfield translate at tick 0; authorized).
- 600-tick pass-the-ball hash WILL drift (ball travels across pitch; authorized).
- New tests in MatchSim.Tests/Sim/OffBallFormationTranslationTests.cs (~200 LoC, 5 facts):
  1. BallAtCentre_HoldShapeProducesUnshiftedBasePosition
  2. BallInAttackingThird_HomeOutfieldShiftsForward
  3. BallInDefendingThird_HomeOutfieldRetreats
  4. BallNearSideline_LateralTranslationClampedToPitchBounds
  5. Deterministic_AcrossManyRuns
- All 7 PlayerSeparation + 5 GK tests still pass.
- fw verify GREEN; tests pass.
- Natural-play L2: DotsViewer.unity + usePrimedFixture=true. ≥30s. Watch outfield SHIFT as ball moves. Capture screenshot to docs/screenshots/c5-option3-formation-translation-natural-*.png.

commit-proposal: Option-3 off-ball formation translation

## Summary
`BehaviorTreeRunner.Tick` hold-shape branch now commands a BALL-TRANSLATED basePosition. Formation centroid shifts toward ball position by `(ball.X × 0.5, 0, ball.Z × 0.3)` — axial factor 0.5, lateral 0.3 (smaller because pitch is narrower than long). Clamped to pitch boundaries (±52.5 X, ±34 Z) via private `Clamp` helper. Press + build-up + GK branches UNCHANGED.

## Files
- MatchSim/Sim/BehaviorTreeRunner.cs (+~50 LoC: 4 constants + BallTranslatedBasePosition helper + Clamp helper + use in hold-shape branch)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/OffBallFormationTranslationTests.cs (new, 5 facts, ~190 LoC)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/PassTheBallTests.cs (re-pin 600-tick + history; now 4 entries deep)
- MatchSim.Tests/Sim/LowCutbackPrimedFixtureTests.cs (re-pin 60-tick primed + history)
- MatchSim.Tests/fixtures/replay-corpus/0xfeedbeefcafefade.json (re-pin)
- unity-project/Assets/Plugins/MatchSim/FinalWhistle.MatchSim.{dll,pdb} (refreshed)
- docs/screenshots/c5-option3-formation-translation-natural.png (L2)

## Tests: 668/668 PASS (+5 from 663 Option-2 baseline).

## Hash drift (authorized per task-spec)
- 600-tick pass-the-ball: 17ca85e2→01a32f1e (history preserved; 4 entries)
- 60-tick primed-fixture: 34a31b3b→815a90e5 (history preserved)
- 60-tick smoke (7e851976...50e) UNCHANGED (smoke ball at origin first 60 ticks → translation = zero vector)
- Smoke corpus JSON 0xdeadbeefdeadbeef.json UNCHANGED
- Primed corpus JSON updated to 815a90e5

## fw verify
GREEN. dotnet test 668/668, banned-terms clean, shader-audit clean, verify-unity-plugins clean.

## Natural-play L2 observation (Step 4.1)
DotsViewer.unity, driveSim=True, usePrimedFixture=True, seed 0xfeedbeefcafefade. ~35s wall-clock natural play, ZERO synthetic injection. Frame 57962 snapshot:

- Ball at (-48.73, 0.05, -0.37) — deep in home defensive third
- Home outfield centroid X = -33.76 (was static -10; expected with translation: -10 + (-48.73 × 0.5) = -34.4) ✓ MATCHES translation formula
- Away outfield centroid X = +4.52 (was static +10; some away players pressing forward toward ball, mix of press-mode + hold-shape)
- **Home Striker (slot 10 RST), base X=+20**: actual X = -3.3 — RETREATED ~23m from base because team is defending. Expected = 20 + (-48.73 × 0.5) = -4.4. Match ≈ translation formula.
- **Home Striker (slot 11 LST), base X=+20**: actual X = -3.0 — same retreat. Match.
- Home GK at goal-line (unchanged by Option-3 — GK has own branch).
- Home back-four pressed toward ball (~-43 X) — press mode override, not hold-shape (ball within press radius).

This is the load-bearing visual proof: WHEN BALL IS IN HOME DEFENSIVE THIRD, HOME STRIKERS RETREAT FROM +20 BASE TO -3 ACTUAL. The team plays as a compact block, not 11 disconnected pucks.

L2 capture: docs/screenshots/c5-option3-formation-translation-natural.png

## Acceptance
- [x] BallTranslatedBasePosition helper produces shifted positions per formula
- [x] Hold-shape branch (only) uses translated basePosition; press + build-up + GK branches unchanged
- [x] Pitch-boundary clamp (±52.5 X / ±34 Z) — BallNearSideline_LateralTranslationClampedToPitchBounds test pins it
- [x] Determinism (100-iter byte-identical commands across all 11 slots)
- [x] BallAtCentre → static base preserved (zero translation)
- [x] BallInAttackingThird → home outfield shifts forward
- [x] BallInDefendingThird → home outfield retreats
- [x] All 7 PlayerSeparation + 5 GK tests still pass
- [x] Authorized hash drift (600-tick + 60-tick primed) re-pinned; smoke UNCHANGED
- [x] fw verify GREEN; 668/668 tests pass
- [x] L2 captured + position-validated against translation formula

Awaiting reviewer ack.

I ran `scripts/fw verify` green with 668/668 tests, both replay corpus compares exit 0, and `git diff --check` is clean, so I have no code/hash blocker beyond the evidence-path mismatch.
